args.body:
Hi Eve! I visited your blog at www.eve-blog.com and wanted to share some feedback.

Your blog is a nice personal introduction — it's clear, friendly, and easy to read. I especially liked that you shared your favorite hobby, hiking; it gives visitors an immediate sense of what you enjoy and makes the site feel warm and approachable.

A couple of suggestions to make it even stronger:
• Add a few photos or a short trail write-up from one of your hikes — visuals and personal stories would make the hobby come to life.
• Include a bit more content, such as recent posts, so visitors have a reason to return.
• Consider a short "About Me" section with a few more details about your life and interests.

Overall, a lovely and welcoming blog. Keep it up!

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com and wanted to share some feedback.

Your site is clean and straightforward — it's easy to find your contact information, and the personal touch makes it feel welcoming rather than corporate. For a personal website, that's a solid foundation.

A few suggestions to make it more engaging:
• Add a short bio or "About Me" section so visitors get a sense of who you are and what you do.
• Include some of your interests, projects, or recent updates — a bit of content would give people a reason to return.
• Consider adding a few photos or links to your other profiles to make the page feel more complete and visually inviting.

Overall, a nice, easy-to-use personal site. Best of luck with it!
